We provide tailored support across the assessment and research lifecycle. Contact us to discuss the scope of your project.

## Psychometrics and measurement

- Classical test theory and item response theory analyses
- Reliability and measurement precision
- Differential item functioning and fairness reviews
- Dimensionality and validity evidence
- Equating, linking, and score reporting support

## Assessment and scale development

- Competency models and test blueprints
- Item development and evaluation
- Standard-setting study design and analysis
- Survey and scale development and validation
- Technical documentation and quality assurance

## Quantitative research consulting

- Research design and sampling
- Statistical analysis and modeling
- Data preparation and reproducible workflows
- Program evaluation and research reporting
